# AZNP - Agentic Zero-Noise Proxy

> Ultra-lightweight Markdown proxy for AI Agents & LLMs with Solana Wallet-based Stateless Micropayments.

AZNP strips HTML bloat, navigation, ads, scripts, and CSS from web pages, converting them into clean, high-density Markdown. It saves 75~90% LLM token costs on average. No signups, passwords, or API Key management required—your Solana Wallet (PublicKey) serves as your stateless account ID.

## Core Capabilities
- Token Reduction: 75~90% average LLM token savings (up to 95% with Advanced Extraction)
- 3-Tier Cascading Engine: Cloudflare Native → Self Extraction → Tier 3 Browser Rendering (JS)
- Multi-Tier Caching: Cache API + KV saving 70~90% CPU on repeated requests
- Stateless Authentication: Solana Ed25519 wallet signatures (`x-wallet-address`, `x-signature`, `x-timestamp`)

## Pricing & Deposit Options (USDC on Solana)
- Free Tier: $0 / month (15 RPM / 1,000 RPD basic conversion, no auth needed)
- Pro Agent: $20 USDC deposit = 12,000 request credits ($0.00166 / req)
- Enterprise: $100 USDC deposit = 80,000 request credits ($0.00125 / req)

## Credit Topup API
- Topup Endpoint: `POST https://aznp-proxy.kerberos79.workers.dev/v1/topup` (Body: `{"wallet": "<SOL_PUBLIC_KEY>", "tx_hash": "<SOL_TX_HASH>"}`)

## API Endpoints
- Primary Conversion: `GET https://aznp-proxy.kerberos79.workers.dev/?url={target_url}`
- Parameters: `url` (required), `mode` (auto | summary), `max_tokens` (number), `render` (true | false), `format` (markdown | json)
- Signature Headers: `x-wallet-address`, `x-timestamp`, `x-signature`
